Open contributions. Guarded publication.

Stewarded by KDV.
Open to community input.

KDV Ecosystems initiates and maintains this community edition. Proposals are reviewed in the repository, changes are recorded and examples must be free of confidential or personal data. This edition publishes a starting model for review, not a claim of established community consensus.

The method and its implementations.

The framework describes how to work. Kolmeia and KDV products are reference implementations and supporting technology. You can apply the model with other tools. Commercial services from KDV Ecosystems are separate from participation in the framework.
